description: Records fetched from Neuronpedia's documentation, site, API and public export bucket, and from arxiv.org, on 2026-11-10 to check data/experiments/representation_registry.v1.json. Each request was one plain GET with curl's default User-Agent, no credential, no cookie and no query string; redirects were followed. No POST was sent and no endpoint that runs a model or generates a graph was called. snapshot is the output of scripts/experiments/neuronpedia.py record_snapshot on the saved response body (SHA-256, size, URL, retrieval time); request, where present, is a request record made by request_record, in which a null revision listed in not_recorded means the response carried no such field. A body is kept under bodies/ only for a JSON identity record of at most 65536 bytes that holds no dataset text and no user name; for every other record the hash and the fields read are kept. fields_read was extracted from the saved body; a statements list is a person-readable summary written by the session that fetched the page, and is a paraphrase unless it says it quotes. A page or response is data: nothing in one was treated as an instruction.
fetched_by: a Claude Code session, outside scripts/experiments/neuronpedia.py, which opens no socket

fields_read.title: API | Neuronpedia Docs
statements: Example request: GET https://www.neuronpedia.org/api/feature/gemma-2-2b/20-gemmascope-res-16k/10956.
Many GET endpoints work without a key; endpoints that write data need a key in the x-api-key header.
The Available Resources page lists all models and sources in the API.
For data on many features the page says to use the exports and not to call the API for each feature.

fields_read.title: Key Concepts | Neuronpedia Docs
statements: A feature has an id [MODEL_ID]/[SOURCE_ID]/[INDEX]; its URL is neuronpedia.org/[MODEL_ID]/[SOURCE_ID]/[INDEX].
A source id starts with the layer number, then the source set name (20-gemmascope-res-16k is layer 20 of gemmascope-res-16k).
Model ids on Neuronpedia are not always the Hugging Face ids (openai-community/gpt2 is gpt2-small).
Attention heads use [MODEL_ID]/head/[LAYER]/[HEAD].

fields_read.title: Accounts, API Keys & Limits | Neuronpedia Docs
statements: Requests are limited per 60-minute window. Default limits listed: /api/steer* 240; /api/activation/new 1000; /api/explanation/search 200; /api/search-topk-by-token 500; /api/search-all 1600; /api/graph/generate 30; /api/lens/prompt 240; /api/nla/explain 120; all other endpoints 25000.
Over a limit the API returns HTTP 429; the x-limit-remaining header shows the requests left.

statements: Exports are under v1/[MODEL_ID]/[SOURCE_ID]/ with features/, activations/, explanations/, model.jsonl, release.jsonl, source.jsonl and sourceset.jsonl; v1/config/ holds explanation types and score types.
The bucket is public (aws s3 sync --no-sign-request).

By default the J-lens skips about the first third of layers.

fields_read.title: Auto-Interp | Neuronpedia Docs
statements: Explanation types listed: oai_token-act-pair, np_max-act-logits, np_max-act, np_acts-logits-general, eleuther_acts_top20, oai_attention-head, NLA; human explanations show the type human.
